scene: A 3D loss surface floating in AR space, showing a curved bowl shape that represents model error over the weight parameter space.
objectives: Explain what a loss surface represents in machine learning
Show how gradient descent iteratively reduces loss
Demonstrate how learning rate affects convergence speed

clips.change: A 3D bowl-shaped surface appears in the AR environment
clips.meaning: Students need to understand that height on this surface represents prediction error before they can appreciate why we want to descend it

clips.change: A point appears on the surface at a high-loss position
clips.meaning: Establishes the starting point of training — far from the minimum

clips.change: An arrow appears showing the gradient direction at the current point
clips.meaning: The gradient points uphill, so we move in the opposite direction to reduce loss

clips.change: The point moves one step downhill and the loss value updates
clips.meaning: Each step is one iteration of gradient descent — loss decreases incrementally
